Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well — TremorHealth’s Q3 planning surfaced faster-than-expected production growth for our customer-facing summarization and embeddings pipelines. We’re looking at a likely +40-60% token run-rate starting July and would like to lock a renewal that covers:

I’ve attached our April run-rate to give a sense of scope. Can Redwood put together a structured option set (tiered discounts by uplift bands and credits) so we can take a concrete ask to finance?

Caroline / Irene,

Quick technical context from the infra side:

- If TremorHealth sustains +50% token volume and keeps similar request patterns (short chats + embeddings heavy), we recommend a staged Dedicated pool for the highest-volume endpoints to keep tail latency consistent.
- Prefix/KV cache warm-up will cause a short burst; plan on a 10–14 day elevated consumption window during cutover.
- For cost modeling, run-rate smoothing can be achieved with a short-term burst window (we call it a "bridge pool") so you don’t pay peak-tier pricing immediately.

Attaching a short runbook that outlines the warm-up sequence and expected warm-up spend. Happy to jump on a 30-min call next week to walk the Tremor infra team through it.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: proposed structure for TremorHealth renewal (do not forward)

Team — internal note on structure I’m comfortable taking to Tremor:

Overview:
- Current effective rate: $0.0009/token (example)
- Target: give Tremor clear incentives for commit uplift without permanently lowering NRR for similar customers

Proposal (tiered, 12-month term):
- Tier A: +30% commit — 8% discount off current rate; 1 month migration credit
- Tier B: +50% commit — 12% discount; 2 weeks migration credit + 6-month price hold
- Tier C: +100% commit — 18% discount; 4 weeks migration credit + 12-month price hold

Other notes:
- Add a temporary "bridge pool" clause: first 30 days of uplift billed at current rate with credits applied after usage stabilization (to avoid immediate over-commitment risk).
- Require usage reporting cadence (monthly) and a quarterly review to adjust commitments early if growth exceeds projections.

If that looks reasonable, I’ll have legal run a redline to the standard amendment and we can package Proposal v2.

Laura
Head of Sales Operations
